purpose: Teach: 潜ん/見送っ/史観/極秘/潜入/バイアス/毒性/頻発

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界に、本気で、絶対、潜んでいるリスク、絶対、見極めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、社員、皆、本気で、頑張れ
lines.en: Look sharp for the risks hiding in this industry. I'm counting on all of you to give this your absolute best.
lines.style: Direct and measured, no wasted syllables. Lean forward slightly on the demands. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone used to being listened to and who doesn't need to raise his voice to be heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。退職する先輩、本気で、絶対、見送ったばかり、本気で、本気、絶対、社員、皆、絶対、寂しい気持ち、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We just said goodbye to our retiring senior, and the whole team is feeling that loss. I'm grateful for what he's given us.
lines.style: Respectful pause on the first sentence, then softer. A moment of genuine reflection, not performance. Warm but measured—the kind of acknowledgment that carries real weight because it's brief.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者の経営史観、本気で、絶対、若手、絶対、引き継いでいけ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The founder's vision for how we do business—I need the younger staff to carry that forward. Make it yours.
lines.style: Steady, almost educational in pace. Not urgent, but intentional. A quiet kind of insistence. The confidence of someone passing something on that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品開発、本気で、絶対、極秘で、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Good. We're moving forward with the new product development in strict confidence. I appreciate your discretion on this.
lines.style: Approving nod in the voice. Clipped, professional. Recognition that Kenji understands the stakes without having to spell them out further. Efficient and warm at once.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合市場、本気で、絶対、潜入調査、絶対、必要だ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: We need to understand what the competition is doing. Get me that intelligence on the market.
lines.style: Sharp pivot to business. Firmer edge than before. Not harsh—just the tone shift of someone who's moved to the next priority. Brief and expectant of execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様アンケート、本気で、絶対、バイアス、絶対、避けるよう、設計、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Right. And on the customer survey—design it so we're not picking up our own biases. Keep that clean.
lines.style: Technical precision without coldness. The language of someone checking a box on a checklist but one that actually matters. Slight emphasis on 'clean'—the standard is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社製品、本気で、絶対、毒性、絶対、ゼロを、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Our products have to be safe. Zero toxicity. That's the floor, not the goal. Make it happen.
lines.style: Intensity rises just slightly. The first real edge of stakes. Not angry, but the shift from manager to someone who won't accept anything less. Definitive close on 'happen'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様クレーム、本気で、絶対、頻発、絶対、しないよう、対応、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're on top of customer complaints—preventing them before they happen. It's working.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. The tone of someone checking off the last item on a long list. Settled, competent, almost tired in a good way. A small exhale at the very end.
